name: create_list_item
description: Add a new item to a user's list (shopping, todo, etc.) with an optional reminder.

list_name.description: Short name of the list e.g. 'shopping', 'todo', 'groceries'.

message.description: The text of the list item.

reminder_date_time_human.description: Optional reminder date/time in human readable format.

name: create_note
description: Create a new note with the given text.

name: delete_list_item
description: Remove an item from a list by searching for it.

search_text.description: Text to match the item to delete.

name: get_list_items
description: Retrieve all items from a specified list.

list_name.description: The name of the list to retrieve.

name: create_list
description: Create a new empty list.

name: delete_list
description: Delete an entire list.

list_name.description: Name of the list to delete.

name: search_notes
description: Search through existing notes by keyword.

name: delete_note
description: Delete a note by matching its title or content.

search_text.description: Text to match the note to delete.

name: mark_list_item_done
description: Mark a list item as completed.

search_text.description: Text to match the item to mark done.

name: share_list
description: Share a list with another contact.

name: edit_note
description: Edit an existing note by appending or replacing its content.

search_text.description: Text to match the note to edit.

new_text.description: New text to append or replace with.

mode.description: 'append' to add to existing or 'replace' to overwrite.

name: pin_note
description: Pin or unpin a note so it stays at the top.

pinned.description: True to pin, false to unpin.

name: tag_note
description: Add or remove a tag/label on a note.

name: archive_note
description: Archive or unarchive a note.

archive.description: True to archive, false to unarchive.

name: create_voice_note
description: Record a voice note with optional transcription.

title.description: Optional title for the voice note.

transcribe.description: Whether to automatically transcribe the recording.

name: create_checklist
description: Create a note with a checklist of items.

name: rename_list
description: Rename an existing list.

name: sort_list
description: Sort list items by a given criteria.

name: duplicate_list
description: Create a copy of an existing list.

name: export_note
description: Export a note as a text file or PDF.

search_text.description: Text to match the note to export.

name: get_all_notes
description: List all notes, optionally filtered by tag.
